optimal.idea: Push opens; on a close, the stack top must be the matching open.
Stack of chars; a '*' pops the last pushed char.
Split on '/'; push names, '..' pops, ignore '.' and empties; join the stack.
Monotonic increasing stack; pop larger preceding digits while k>0 to minimize the number.
Stack; a right-mover meeting a left-mover collides, popping the smaller until resolved.
Simulate: push pushed[] and pop whenever the top matches the next popped[] value.

brute.idea: For each element scan right for the first greater.

optimal.idea: Monotonic decreasing stack over nums2 builds a next-greater map; look up nums1.

brute.idea: For each element scan up to n-1 following positions (wrapping) for the first greater.

optimal.idea: Monotonic stack over the array traversed twice (mod n) to handle the circular wrap.

brute.idea: For each element scan left for the first smaller.

optimal.idea: Monotonic increasing stack; the top after popping >= current is the previous smaller.

brute.idea: For each day scan forward for a warmer day.

optimal.idea: Monotonic decreasing stack of indices; on a warmer day, pop and record the day gap.

brute.idea: On each call, scan backward counting consecutive prices <= today's.

optimal.idea: Monotonic decreasing stack of (price, span); pop <= current and accumulate spans.

brute.idea: Enumerate all subarrays, sum each minimum.

optimal.idea: For each element count subarrays where it's the min via previous/next smaller (monotonic stack).

brute.idea: For every subarray track max-min and sum them.

optimal.idea: Sum of maxes minus sum of mins, each via the subarray-contribution monotonic-stack technique.

brute.idea: For each bar expand left/right while >= its height for the widest rectangle.

optimal.idea: Monotonic increasing stack; on a smaller bar, pop and compute area with the popped height.

brute.idea: Try every pair of rows/columns as rectangle bounds and check it's all 1s.

optimal.idea: Build a histogram of consecutive 1s per row, apply largest-rectangle-in-histogram each row.
Sort by position desc; compute time to target, a car joins a fleet if not slower than the one ahead.

Reverse the infix, convert to postfix (swap brackets), then reverse the result.
Scan right to left; pop two operands per operator and push '(a op b)'.
Scan left to right; pop two operands per operator and push '(a op b)'.
Scan right to left; pop two operands per operator and push 'ab op'.
Scan left to right; pop two operands per operator and push 'op ab'.

brute.idea: For each window scan all k elements for the max.

optimal.idea: Monotonic decreasing deque of indices; front is the window max, drop out-of-window and smaller.
One queue; after each push, rotate the queue so the new element sits at the front.

brute.idea: For each person check they know no one and everyone knows them.

optimal.idea: Stack-eliminate candidates: if A knows B, drop A else drop B; verify the survivor.
